immutable.rationale: Read-only state is independent of a logical session and native carrier.

instance.rationale: The value belongs to an instance and is reachable from every carrier through the instance context.

managed_guc.rationale: Generated GUC storage lives in heap-backed logical role or session state; parameter ownership refines semantic_owner.

role.rationale: Generated role storage follows the logical PostgreSQL backend and is not native-thread storage.

session.rationale: Generated session storage follows the SQL session execution context.

overrides.rationale: The value may point into the current C stack and must never survive release of a carrier.
Logical replication callbacks may contain carrier-stack addresses while an apply operation is active.
Error callbacks are commonly stack allocated and cannot move with the logical backend.
Stack-depth accounting must be rebound to the native stack used for each execution quantum.
The generated GUC lexer temporarily points at a parser stack jump buffer and restores the saved value before returning.

runtime_carrier_fields.name: previous_execution
runtime_carrier_fields.rationale: Restores the worker TLS root after a quantum.

runtime_carrier_fields.name: previous_stack_base
runtime_carrier_fields.rationale: Prevents stack-depth metadata from leaking between carriers.

runtime_carrier_fields.name: exit_jump
runtime_carrier_fields.rationale: The terminal error boundary is allocated on the active carrier.

runtime_carrier_fields.name: saved_errno
runtime_carrier_fields.rationale: The C runtime error slot is carrier-local and must not become session state.

runtime_carrier_fields.name: previous_locale
runtime_carrier_fields.rationale: The worker locale must be restored before it executes another session.

runtime_carrier_fields.name: exit_jump_ready
runtime_carrier_fields.rationale: An armed jump target is valid only on its creating carrier.

runtime_carrier_fields.name: execution_bound
runtime_carrier_fields.rationale: Tracks exclusive ownership of the carrier frame.
